shared_tail.surface: جبير بن أبي سليمان بن جبير بن مطعم

notes: Two branches joined by «ح»; «قالا حدثنا عبادة» marks their meeting, so the names after it are the shared tail.
«- المعنى -» is a gloss and is left out.
Uthman's different wording of the supplication, and Abu Dawud's and Waki's remarks, add wording to the same route: left out.
Ibn Umar is the Companion whose words the report relays: last link.
